title: Neuroexistentialism, Improvisational Research, and Slow Partying by Joseph Dumit
excerpt: This is ~35 minute talk by Joseph Dumit on some very diverse topics, including Warren McCulloch's work, improvisational science, and the lichen lifestyle. The links to papers he referenced and audio of the Q&A session are here:  https://thoughtforms.life/a-few-talks-discussions-l
